description: This file defines the 'Fields' class within the Api\V8\Param\Options namespace. It extends a base option class and provides functionality to add and validate 'fields' options using Symfony's OptionsResolver and Validator components. The class includes logic to validate field names against a regex pattern, check for existence of fields in a bean, and throw exceptions for invalid fields.

classes.name: Fields
classes.description: Class for defining and validating 'fields' option with regex validation and bean attribute existence checks.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds and configures the 'fields' option to an OptionsResolver, including validation and normalization logic.
